important.delete_param_name: Some deletes take `delete_list` (the UI's paramsubmit), others take the id field. Choosing the wrong one changes behaviour. See the house finding.
important.house_delete_bypass: /json/options/delhouseflex with `delete_list` skips the in-use check. With `houseid` it returns error 8 when users reference the house. Test: house 92 was deleted via delete_list while user 862 (mcptest12) still referenced it. The orphaned reference remains on the demo. The MCP must send `houseid` only, never `delete_list`, and must report referencing users in dry-run.
